AST reachability proof over lock coverage; no JSON shape, exit code, hint or output determinism in it — out of this role's domain. Read whole. LockFilePath hashes filepath.Abs(target), which is lexical and honours $PWD, so two spellings of one directory take DIFFERENT locks. Measured on /tmp/tp-dev/tp: with a holder on the /private spelling, `tp add` with PWD=/private/tmp/tp-ax2 exits 4 after 1.05s; the same command, same cwd, PWD=/tmp/tp-ax2 exits 0 in 0.00s and writes. ls .tp/locks shows two locks for one target.
